name: Agent Apps
author: vladkarok
description: Installed and newest version of the AI desktop apps behind Omarchy's Install > AI menu, with a one-click local build of Omarchy's own recipe at the vendor's newest release.

barWidget.description: Shows when a vendor has released a newer version of an installed AI app than the [omarchy] repo carries, and builds Omarchy's recipe at that version in a terminal when you press Update.

schema.label: Notify on new versions
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a vendor publishes a version newer than the installed one.
